# Medical Clinic Operations Dashboard

## Overview
This dashboard tracks outpatient clinic performance, including daily appointment volume, no-show rates, patient satisfaction, and wait time metrics. It helps clinic administrators optimize scheduling, reduce gaps, and improve the patient experience.

## Key Metrics
- Daily Appointments: 48
- No-Show Rate: 12.3%
- Patient Satisfaction Score: 4.1 / 5.0

## Insights
- No-show rate has declined 2.1% since SMS reminder automation was activated last quarter.
- Telehealth appointments now account for 31% of total visits, reducing in-clinic wait times.
- Patient satisfaction scores are highest for follow-up visits and lowest for new patient intake.
